normalization: Anchored tie-aware midrank percentile 100*(N-midrank)/(N-1) over common FBS teams with at least one completed outcome and one measured Performance game; a singleton receives50. No zero-filled missing model.

calibration.interpretation: Older-only2018-2019 probability mapping from the frozen retrospective comparison. The model percentile index is not itself a probability.

eligibility: Available unfinished source FBS-FBS fixtures strictly after actual completed capture, source timestamps and source cutoff, within seven days of capture. Primary both teams>=4 outcome and>=4 measured Performance games; secondary both>=1. The same fixtures score all seven fixed models.
capturePolicy: Actual capture must follow freeze and all retained source/generation times. Older retained inputs are allowed if honestly dated. Exclusive immutable write and pre/postwrite kickoff guards; no retrospective backfill. A matching current Performance artifact is required. Capture timestamps are local evidence, not an externally certified public-registration service.
selectionPolicy: Earliest eligible immutable capture per season/game, selected before examining results. Never replace an excluded earliest capture with a newer favorable forecast. Participant/venue changes or corrected kickoff at/before capture are excluded; rescheduling beyond seven days is excluded. Duplicate checkpoints count as one game.
sourcePolicy: Read the existing weekly completed primary snapshot, matching derived Performance artifact and normalized season/schedule. No extra source requests. Store derived model evidence and source hashes only; never raw API responses, normalized source arrays or credentials.
scoring: Rank-pick accuracy with half credit for a tie; separately calibrated venue-aware probability accuracy, Brier error and log loss. Report primary/all-eligible, year/regular/postseason/venue/Top25-union/disagreement groups, pending/excluded fixtures and current-source tracking coverage. No scored games means evidence pending.
reviewPolicy: Weekly summaries are descriptive. Review the frozen experiment after2026 postseason results are available; do not choose a favorable stopping week or tune weights to interim outcomes. Future-game prediction does not establish a uniquely correct earned-achievement order. No automatic promotion; public formula changes require a separate benefit/tradeoff review.
operations: Existing Sunday08:00America/Denver workflow; zero additional CFBD calls, services or charges. Optional research failures do not block primary rankings. Keep SOR, Predictive Strength and Performance separate on the site.
setupStatus: No prospective observations at setup. First actual capture is the next successful existing weekly refresh; Friday/Saturday fixtures before it remain explicitly uncaptured.
changePolicy: Version and preserve old protocols and observations for any numerical model, calibration, eligibility or pinned implementation change. No silent retuning.
